gitCommit.subject: Automate POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken API tests
gitCommit.body:
Automate POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken API tests

Seven functional tests (AUTH-022 through AUTH-028) and two contract
tests covering the success path, both credential-failure classes, and
the four required-field variants. AUTH-027/028 use raw request.post()
for the absent-key cases, matching the post-user precedent.

Back-fills the Automation field in the test-cases file for all seven
cases — no test case was skipped by the priority filter, since none
of this endpoint's conditions are Low priority.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
